digest.component_or_area: dependency management / wiki rendering / lint toolchain
propositions: pypandoc-binary must be bumped from 1.15 to 1.17 and ruff from 0.16.1 to 0.16.2 in pyproject.toml and uv.lock while keeping mcp constraint at >=1.28.1,<2 (deferring mcp 2.0 to epic 732b)

all hard-coded pin references (NOTICE, test assertions, ADR 0095/0096, wiki_render.py docstring, generator test literals) must be updated to reflect pypandoc-binary 1.17 bundling pandoc 3.9 instead of 3.6.1

byte-safety baseline for wiki rendering must be re-established by updating LEGACY_PANDOC_VERSION and both SUPPORTED_PANDOC_BINARY_SHA256 fingerprints, then regenerating legacy output fixtures via the generator script
ruff 0.16.2 must not introduce new lint violations or formatting changes to existing code; if it does, apply minimal fixes
the change must be landed via Gerrit with rebar-ticket trailer and DCO sign-off, with mcp 2.0 deferral documented in a ticket comment
